Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human liver carcinoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HepG2 cells, an epithelial-like hepatocellular carcinoma/hepatoblastoma-like liver tumor line from a 15-year-old male and a common model for hepatic metabolism, toxicology, and liver regulatory elements.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from cultured hepatic tumor cells: nuclei are prepared from the full sample, accessible chromatin is tagmented with Tn5 transposase, and libraries measure population-average enhancer and promoter accessibility.
